categories_thin: Insurance agencies: one independent agency only (CNJ). Every other agency search returned brand-franchised offices (State Farm, etc.), which the rule excludes.
Tutoring / test prep: only national franchise centres (Mathnasium and similar) with South Amboy mailing addresses; no independent tutoring or test-prep business found.

Independent retail: one appliance dealer (JC Appliances) added; still no hardware, bicycle, music or appliance showroom of any other kind operating in town. The Broadway strip is mainly food, liquor, salons and auto.

Manufacturing / wholesale: the industrial land is largely logistics real estate; the only named manufacturers are the three in the city directory plus Cambridge Pavers. A contract manufacturer (Cifelli & Sons, 4470 Bordentown Ave) was left out - directory only, and the street number suggests the Sayreville/Parlin stretch.
Physical therapy / chiropractic: one independent PT clinic; the other local PT options are regional chains (JAG, Kessler). Chiropractic coverage is five practices.
Attorneys: seven offices listed after this revision, but most South Amboy lawyers appear to practise from home or shared suites and are only reachable through aggregators.
Primary care and specialists: thin. The town has one walk-in centre, one pediatric group and one solo internist; specialists are mostly in Perth Amboy, Old Bridge and Sayreville.
caveats: One multi-site rule, applied throughout this revision: excluded are franchise/brand-network locations (branded insurance agencies such as the State Farm office now at amboyinsuranceagent.com, dental/other franchise brands, Go Go Car Wash), multi-state or statewide network branches (Acelero Learning, Horizon Termite Control, the YMCA of MEWSA branch), and a contracted in-school before/after-care programme (Jesse Selover Preschool run by Leading Edge). Removed this revision on that rule: South Amboy YMCA, Acelero Learning South Amboy, Jesse Selover Preschool, Horizon Termite Control. Kept: locally named, single-site operations even where the owner runs a few nearby offices or campuses (Venetian Post Acute's one South Amboy campus, Ivy Pediatrics, EZ Wheels' South Amboy branch), because the site itself is a local independent business rather than a franchise outlet.

Removed as out-of-town: Carter & Sons Roofing (company site places the office at 456 Smith St, Perth Amboy) and Pride Landscape Supply (company locations page gives 350 Ernston Rd, Parlin/Sayreville).

Removed as unverifiable/lead-generation listings: 'South Amboy Roofing & Roof Repair' (117 S Stevens Ave) and 'South Amboy Roofing Services' (334 2nd St) had no reviews and no corroboration, and 'South Amboy NJ Locksmith' used a dispatch address shared with an unrelated salon with templated copy and no named operator.
Removed as an excluded franchise: 'Amboy Insurance Agent' - the domain now serves a State Farm captive agent page (Juan Nava, 963 US Highway 9).
The city's Business & Non-Profit Directory is the backbone of this list but shows signs of age (duplicate rows, rows with no phone). Treat single-directory entries as leads to be confirmed.

Several businesses carry a South Amboy (08879) mailing address but sit on Route 9 or Route 35 outside the municipality; these are flagged in the address/notes fields. 08879 also covers parts of Old Bridge and Sayreville.

Boundary calls kept with a note rather than dropped: Venetian Post Acute (single campus of a multi-facility operator), the Vrola/Tidal Seafood food-processing plant, and businesses that market to South Amboy from a neighbouring base (Nunez Home Pro, Accurate Conditioning, TFF, Choppers).
Where a listing showed no street number or phone, the field says 'Unknown' rather than a guess; confirm those before outreach.

Two directory rows sometimes describe one business (Broadway Barber House, Tanchyk DMD, Venetian Post Acute, Vrola/Primal/Tidal, Ivy Pediatrics). Each is entered once with both addresses in the address/notes fields.
data_gaps: OpenStreetMap Overpass was not re-attempted this revision; it had timed out on the first pass, so no OSM completeness cross-check exists.
Yellow Pages, Superpages, BBB category pages, ChamberOfCommerce.com and hub.biz return HTTP 403 / Cloudflare blocks; YellowPages and Superpages content was only usable through search-result snippets.
lawyer.com and usattorneynetwork.com return HTTP 403, so the phone numbers recorded for James P. Vail and Joseph R. Bulman come from directory snippets and are unverified.
weathermenmechanical.com returns HTTP 403 to automated fetching; the site is recorded from search results (company title and domain) rather than read.

The city publishes no tenant roster for 108 S Broadway or 116 N Broadway, so the suite-by-suite sweep could not be completed. Confirmed tenants listed: Bulman and Vail at 108 S Broadway (plus Ivy Pediatrics' business office per the city directory); AMGC Roofing and Men With Tools on the second floor at 116 N Broadway (Wells Fargo branch at street level is excluded as a bank).
Jeffrey A. Gee, DDS labels his 329 South Pine Ave address as Sayreville while other directories call it South Amboy; the municipality was not confirmed.
Google Maps served a 'limited view' (about five results per query) in the first pass, so trades categories remain partly enumerated.
No South Amboy-specific chamber of commerce member directory exists online; the Old Bridge-Sayreville-South Amboy chamber has no public member list.
New Jersey business-licence and registered-agent bulk data were not consulted; home-based contractors and consultancies are certainly undercounted.

Candidates not added for lack of a confirmable local presence: MS-I Consulting (site says it serves Union County), Broadway Computer Repair and CRTS (single stale directory rows), Next Level Boxing & Fitness (in-home training, no premises), Cifelli & Sons (directory only, likely outside town).
